notablePrerequisites: Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness. You control at least three enchantments.
easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Sanctum Weaver.
description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Sanctum Weaver by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
